# Motion.page SDK — Real-World Examples

## Basic Animations

### Fade In
```ts
Motion('fade-in', '#hero', {
  from: { opacity: 0 },
  duration: 0.8,
  ease: 'power2.out',
}).play();
```

### Slide from Direction
```ts
// Slide up
Motion('slide-up', '.card', {
  from: { opacity: 0, y: 40 },
  duration: 0.6,
  ease: 'power3.out',
}).play();

// Slide from left
Motion('slide-right', '.panel', {
  from: { opacity: 0, x: -60 },
  duration: 0.7,
  ease: 'power2.out',
}).play();
```

### Scale Entrance
```ts
Motion('pop-in', '.badge', {
  from: { scale: 0, opacity: 0 },
  duration: 0.5,
  ease: 'back.out',
}).play();
```

### Rotate
```ts
Motion('spin', '.icon', {
  to: { rotate: 360 },
  duration: 1.5,
  ease: 'linear',
  repeat: -1,
}).play();
```

### Color Transition
```ts
Motion('theme-switch', '#banner', {
  to: { backgroundColor: '#1a1a2e', color: '#e0e0ff' },
  duration: 0.5,
  ease: 'power2.inOut',
}).onClick({ target: '#dark-toggle', toggle: 'reverse' });
```

### Multiple Properties
```ts
Motion('card-entrance', '.feature-card', {
  from: { opacity: 0, y: 30, scale: 0.95 },
  duration: 0.7,
  ease: 'power3.out',
  stagger: { each: 0.1, from: 'start' },
}).onPageLoad();
```

## Scroll Animations

### Basic Scroll Reveal (play once)
```ts
// each: true → independent timeline per matched element
Motion('section-reveal', '.section', {
  from: { opacity: 0, y: 50 },
  duration: 0.7,
  ease: 'power2.out',
}).onScroll({
  each: true,
  toggleActions: 'play none none none',
  start: 'top 85%',
  end:   'top 40%',
});
```

### Scrub with Smoothing
```ts
Motion('scrub-reveal', '.content-block', {
  from: { opacity: 0, y: 40 },
  duration: 1,
}).onScroll({
  scrub: 1.5,   // 1.5s smoothing lag
  start: 'top 90%',
  end:   'top 40%',
});
```

### Pin + Scrub
```ts
Motion('sticky-anim', '.sticky-content', {
  from: { opacity: 0, scale: 0.8 },
  duration: 1,
}).onScroll({
  scrub: true,
  pin: true,           // pin defaults to 'top top' start
  end: '+=500',        // 500px of scroll travel
});
```

### Horizontal Scroll Gallery
```ts
const sections = Motion.utils.toArray('.h-section');
Motion('h-gallery', '.h-track', {
  to: { x: `-${(sections.length - 1) * 100}%` },
  duration: 1,
}).onScroll({
  scrub: true,
  pin: true,
  start: 'top top',
  end: `+=${sections.length * 100}%`,
  snap: 1 / (sections.length - 1),
});
```

### Parallax Layers
```ts
// Background moves slower than scroll
Motion('parallax-bg', '.hero-bg', {
  to: { y: -150 },
}).onScroll({ scrub: 1, start: 'top top', end: 'bottom top' });

// Foreground element
Motion('parallax-fg', '.hero-text', {
  to: { y: -60 },
}).onScroll({ scrub: 0.5, start: 'top top', end: 'bottom top' });
```

### Progress-Based with onUpdate Callback
```ts
Motion('progress-bar', '.progress-fill', {
  from: { width: '0%' },
  to:   { width: '100%' },
  duration: 1,
  onUpdate: (progress) => {
    document.querySelector('.progress-label')!.textContent =
      `${Math.round(progress * 100)}%`;
  },
}).onScroll({ scrub: true, start: 'top top', end: 'bottom bottom' });
```

### Scroll with Snap Points
```ts
Motion('snapped-sections', '.snap-panel', {
  from: { opacity: 0.3 },
  duration: 1,
}).onScroll({
  scrub: true,
  each: true,
  snap: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1],
});
```

### Markers for Debugging
```ts
Motion('debug-anim', '.target', {
  from: { opacity: 0 },
  duration: 1,
}).onScroll({
  scrub: true,
  markers: {
    startColor: 'blue',
    endColor: 'orange',
    fontSize: '10px',
    indent: 20,
  },
});
```

### Pin a Parent While Child Animates
```ts
Motion('reveal-content', '.content-inner', {
  from: { opacity: 0, y: 60 },
  duration: 1,
  ease: 'power2.out',
}).onScroll({
  scrub: true,
  pin: '.section-wrapper',   // pins the PARENT, not the animated child
  start: 'top top',
  end: '+=800',
});
```

## Text Animations

### Character Reveal with Stagger
```ts
Motion('chars-in', 'h1', {
  split: 'chars',
  from:  { opacity: 0, y: 20 },
  duration: 0.4,
  stagger: { each: 0.03, from: 'start' },
  ease: 'power2.out',
}).onPageLoad();
```

### Word Reveal
```ts
Motion('words-in', '.tagline', {
  split: 'words',
  from:  { opacity: 0, x: -15 },
  duration: 0.5,
  stagger: { each: 0.06, from: 'start' },
  ease: 'power3.out',
}).onPageLoad();
```

### Line Reveal with Mask (slide-up from clip)
```ts
Motion('lines-mask', 'h2', {
  split:   'lines',
  mask:    true,
  from:    { y: '110%' },
  duration: 0.7,
  stagger:  0.08,
  ease: 'power3.out',
}).onPageLoad();
```

### Split Text + Scroll Trigger
```ts
Motion('scroll-chars', '.section-title', {
  split:   'words',
  mask:    true,
  from:    { y: '100%', opacity: 0 },
  duration: 0.6,
  stagger:  { each: 0.05 },
  ease: 'power2.out',
}).onScroll({
  each: true,
  toggleActions: 'play none none none',
  start: 'top 85%',
});
```

### Typewriter Effect
```ts
Motion('typewriter', '.terminal-text', {
  split:   'chars',
  from:    { opacity: 0 },
  duration: 0,           // instant per character
  stagger:  { each: 0.07, from: 'start' },
}).onPageLoad();
```

### CSS Targeting Split Elements
```ts
// Split the headline
Motion('styled-chars', 'h1', {
  split: 'chars',
  from:  { opacity: 0, rotateY: 90 },
  duration: 0.5,
  stagger: 0.04,
}).onPageLoad();
```
```css
/* CSS can target individual split spans */
[data-split-char]:nth-child(3)  { color: hotpink; }
[data-split-word]:first-child   { font-weight: bold; }
[data-split-line]               { overflow: hidden; }
```

## Text Flapper

Split-flap / character-scramble effects. Requires `split: 'chars'`. The `flap` property selects the visual style; `from`/`to` compose alongside the flap effect (per-cycle on each intermediate character).

### Board-Style Departure Flap
```ts
Motion('board', '.headline', {
  split: 'chars',
  flap: { type: 'board', cycles: [2, 5], styledBoard: true },
  duration: 2,
  stagger: 0.08,
}).play();
```

### Flip with CSS Composition
```ts
// flip routes transforms through TransformCache so additional
// from/to properties (y, x, scale) compose without conflict.
// Note: 'fade' owns opacity and 'blur' owns filter — don't compose those.
Motion('flip-compose', '.title', {
  split: 'chars',
  flap: { type: 'flip' },
  from: { opacity: 0, y: 10 },
  to: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
  duration: 1.5,
  stagger: 0.04,
}).play();
```

### Custom Effect with `type: 'none'`
```ts
// 'none' runs the cycle counter without writing any built-in style —
// use your own CSS on [data-split-char] to drive the visual.
Motion('custom-flap', '.scramble', {
  split: 'chars',
  flap: { type: 'none', cycles: 3 },
  from: { scale: 0.5, opacity: 0 },
  to: { scale: 1, opacity: 1 },
  duration: 1.2,
  stagger: 0.03,
}).play();
```

### Matrix / Charset Example
```ts
Motion('matrix', '.code-text', {
  split: 'chars',
  flap: { type: 'fade', charset: 'alphanumeric', cycles: [3, 6] },
  duration: 1.8,
  stagger: 0.05,
}).onPageLoad();
```

## Hover & Click

### Card Lift on Hover
```ts
Motion('card-lift', '.card', {
  to: {
    y: -8,
    boxShadow: '0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
  },
  duration: 0.3,
  ease: 'power2.out',
}).onHover({ each: true, onLeave: 'reverse' });
```

### Button Scale + Color
```ts
Motion('btn-hover', '.btn-primary', {
  to: {
    scale: 1.05,
    backgroundColor: '#0077ff',
  },
  duration: 0.25,
  ease: 'power2.out',
}).onHover({ each: true, onLeave: 'reverse', leaveDelay: 0.05 });
```

### Menu Toggle with onClick
```ts
Motion('nav-menu', '#nav-dropdown', {
  from: { height: 0, opacity: 0 },
  to:   { height: 'auto' },
  duration: 0.4,
  ease: 'power2.inOut',
}).onClick({ target: '#menu-toggle', toggle: 'reverse' });
```

### Hover with leaveDelay
```ts
// Tooltip stays visible 0.3s after mouse leaves
Motion('tooltip', '.tooltip', {
  from: { opacity: 0, y: 8, scale: 0.95 },
  duration: 0.2,
}).onHover({ target: '.tooltip-trigger', onLeave: 'reverse', leaveDelay: 0.3 });
```

### Click with secondTarget
```ts
// Clicking the icon OR the label both trigger the same animation
Motion('accordion', '.accordion-body', {
  from: { height: 0 },
  to:   { height: 'auto' },
  duration: 0.35,
  ease: 'power2.inOut',
}).onClick({
  target:       '.accordion-title',
  secondTarget: '.accordion-icon',
  toggle: 'reverse',
});
```

## Page Transitions

### Fade Out on Exit
```ts
Motion('page-exit', 'body', {
  to: { opacity: 0 },
  duration: 0.4,
  ease: 'power2.in',
}).onPageExit();
```

### Slide Out on Exit
```ts
Motion('page-exit', '#page-wrapper', {
  to: { x: '-100%', opacity: 0 },
  duration: 0.5,
  ease: 'power3.in',
}).onPageExit({ skipHref: ['anchor', 'mailto'] });
```

### Include/Exclude Specific Links
```ts
// Only fire for internal nav links
Motion('nav-exit', 'main', {
  to: { opacity: 0, y: 20 },
  duration: 0.35,
}).onPageExit({
  mode: 'include',
  selectors: 'nav a[href^="/"]',
  skipHref: ['anchor', 'mailto'],
});
```

### Page Load Intro Sequence
```ts
Motion('page-intro', [
  { target: '.site-logo',  from: { opacity: 0, y: -20 }, duration: 0.5 },
  { target: '.nav-links',  from: { opacity: 0 }, duration: 0.4, position: '<0.1' },
  { target: '.hero-title', from: { opacity: 0, y: 30 }, duration: 0.7, position: '+=0.1' },
  { target: '.hero-cta',   from: { opacity: 0, scale: 0.9 }, duration: 0.4, position: '<0.2' },
]).onPageLoad();
```

## Mouse & Gesture

### Mouse Parallax Depth Layers
```ts
// Layer 1: slow, subtle
Motion('parallax-1', '.layer-bg', {
  from: { x: -10, y: -10 },
  to:   { x: 10,  y: 10  },
}).onMouseMove({ type: 'axis', smooth: 0.15, startProgress: 0.5, leaveProgress: 0.5 });

// Layer 2: medium
Motion('parallax-2', '.layer-mid', {
  from: { x: -25, y: -25 },
  to:   { x: 25,  y: 25  },
}).onMouseMove({ type: 'axis', smooth: 0.1 });

// Layer 3: fast, close
Motion('parallax-3', '.layer-fg', {
  from: { x: -50, y: -50 },
  to:   { x: 50,  y: 50  },
}).onMouseMove({ type: 'axis', smooth: 0.06 });
```

### Axis-Locked Mouse Follow
```ts
// Only horizontal axis
Motion('follow-x', '.marker', {
  from: { x: -30 },
  to:   { x: 30 },
  axis: 'x',
}).onMouseMove({ type: 'axis', smooth: 0.08, startProgress: 0, leaveProgress: 0 });
```

### Swipe Gallery with Gesture
```ts
Motion('swipe-cards', '.card', {
  to: { x: -100, opacity: 0 },
  duration: 0.4,
  ease: 'power2.inOut',
}).onGesture({
  types: ['touch', 'pointer'],
  events: {
    LeftComplete:  'playNext',
    RightComplete: 'playPrevious',
  },
  each: true,       // Required for playNext/playPrevious
  dragMinimum: 50,
  lockAxis: true,
});
```

### Wheel-Driven Progress
```ts
Motion('wheel-scroll', '.gallery', {
  to: { x: '-80%' },
  duration: 1,
}).onGesture({
  types: ['wheel'],
  events: {
    Up:   'progressDown',
    Down: 'progressUp',
  },
  animationStep: 0.08,
  smooth: 0.3,
});
```

### Drag Interaction
```ts
Motion('drag-reveal', '.drag-element', {
  to: { x: 300 },
  duration: 0.5,
}).onGesture({
  types: ['pointer'],
  events: {
    Drag:    'play',
    DragEnd: 'reverse',
    Right:   'progressUp',
    Left:    'progressDown',
  },
  dragMinimum: 5,
  lockAxis: true,
});
```

## Custom Cursors

### Basic Dot Cursor
```ts
Motion('cursor', 'body', { duration: 0 }).onCursor({
  smooth: 0.1,
  hideNative: true,
  default: { width: 10, height: 10, borderRadius: '50%', backgroundColor: '#fff' },
  hover: {
    targets: ['a', 'button'],
    width: 36,
    height: 36,
    backgroundColor: 'transparent',
    border: '2px solid white',
    duration: 0.2,
  },
  click: { scale: 0.75, duration: 0.08 },
});
```

### Text Cursor with Labels
```ts
Motion('cursor-text', 'body', { duration: 0 }).onCursor({
  type: 'text',
  smooth: 0.08,
  hideNative: true,
  default: { width: 10, height: 10, borderRadius: '50%', backgroundColor: '#fff' },
  hover:   { width: 80, height: 80, backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)' },
  text: { fontSize: '11px', fontWeight: '600', color: '#fff', letterSpacing: '0.05em' },
});
```
```html
<a href="/work" mp-cursor-text="View">Our Work</a>
<button mp-cursor-tooltip="Submit">Send</button>
```

### Media Cursor with Images
```ts
Motion('cursor-media', 'body', { duration: 0 }).onCursor({
  type: 'media',
  smooth: 0.12,
  hideNative: true,
  default: { width: 14, height: 14, borderRadius: '50%', backgroundColor: '#fff' },
  hover:   { width: 100, height: 70, borderRadius: '8px' },
  media:   { objectFit: 'cover', borderRadius: '8px' },
});
```
```html
<div class="project" mp-cursor-media="/img/project-1-thumb.jpg">Project 1</div>
<div class="project" mp-cursor-media="https://cdn.example.com/clip.mp4">Project 2</div>
```

### Squeeze Effect Cursor
```ts
Motion('cursor-squeeze', 'body', { duration: 0 }).onCursor({
  smooth: 0.1,
  hideNative: true,
  squeeze: { min: 0.8, max: 1.3, multiplier: 1.2 },
  default: { width: 12, height: 12, borderRadius: '50%', backgroundColor: '#ff0066' },
  hover: {
    targets: ['a', '[data-link]'],
    width: 44,
    height: 44,
    duration: 0.25,
  },
});
```

## SVG

### Draw SVG Path on Scroll
```ts
Motion('draw-on-scroll', '#line-path', {
  from: { drawSVG: '0% 0%' },
  to:   { drawSVG: '0% 100%' },
  duration: 1,
}).onScroll({ scrub: true, start: 'top 80%', end: 'bottom 20%' });
```

### Draw SVG on Page Load
```ts
Motion('draw-logo', '.logo-path', {
  from: { drawSVG: '0% 0%', opacity: 0 },
  to:   { drawSVG: '0% 100%' },
  duration: 1.5,
  ease: 'power2.inOut',
  stagger: 0.1,
}).onPageLoad();
```

### Motion Path Animation
```ts
// Animate along a DOM SVG path
Motion('orbit', '.dot', {
  to: { path: { target: '#orbit-path', rotate: true } },
  duration: 4,
  ease: 'linear',
  repeat: -1,
}).play();

// Inline SVG path data — no DOM element required
Motion('wave', '.particle', {
  to: {
    path: {
      target: 'M 0 200 C 100 100 200 300 300 200 C 400 100 500 300 600 200',
      rotate: false,
    },
  },
  duration: 3,
  ease: 'power2.inOut',
}).play();
```

### DrawSVG Object Format
```ts
// Object form: values are percentages 0–100, NOT 0–1
Motion('partial-draw', '#circle-path', {
  from: { drawSVG: { start: 0, end: 0 } },
  to:   { drawSVG: { start: 10, end: 90 } },   // 10% to 90% of stroke
  duration: 1,
  ease: 'power2.out',
}).onPageLoad();
```

## Clip Path

The `clip-path` (or camelCase `clipPath`) value is a CSS shape function string. Smooth interpolation requires the **same shape on both ends**; cross-shape animations hard-swap at progress ≥ 0.5. Polygon vertex counts must match between `from` and `to`. The renderer also writes `-webkit-clip-path` for older Safari.

### Circle Reveal
```ts
Motion('reveal', '#hero', {
  from: { 'clip-path': 'circle(0% at 50% 50%)' },
  to:   { 'clip-path': 'circle(75% at 50% 50%)' },
  duration: 1,
  ease: 'power2.out',
}).onPageLoad();
```

### Inset Crop with Rounded Corners
```ts
Motion('crop', '.card', {
  from: { 'clip-path': 'inset(0px round 0px)' },
  to:   { 'clip-path': 'inset(20px round 16px)' },
  duration: 0.8,
  ease: 'power2.inOut',
}).onScroll({ scrub: true });
```

### Polygon Slide (4-Vertex Sweep)
```ts
// from-only: the SDK reads current clip-path as the "to" endpoint.
Motion('slide', '#banner', {
  from: { clipPath: 'polygon(0% 0%, 0% 0%, 0% 100%, 0% 100%)' },
  duration: 1,
  ease: 'power3.out',
}).onPageLoad();
```

### Polygon Triangle Morph
```ts
// Vertex counts MUST match (3 ↔ 3) for smooth morphing.
Motion('triangle', '.shape', {
  from: { 'clip-path': 'polygon(50% 0%, 0% 100%, 100% 100%)' },
  to:   { 'clip-path': 'polygon(50% 100%, 0% 0%, 100% 0%)' },
  duration: 1.4,
  ease: 'power2.inOut',
  repeat: { times: -1, yoyo: true },
}).play();
```

### Hover Wipe
```ts
Motion('wipe', '.card', {
  from: { 'clip-path': 'polygon(0% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%)' },
  to:   { 'clip-path': 'polygon(0% 0%, 0% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%)' },
  duration: 0.5,
  ease: 'power2.inOut',
}).onHover({ each: true, onLeave: 'reverse' });
```

## Advanced Patterns

### `from` / `to` Resolution

The SDK automatically fills in the missing endpoint from the element's **current computed CSS**. Only specify both when neither endpoint is the element's natural state.

**Natural CSS defaults** (omit from `to` when they appear): `opacity: 1` · `x: 0` · `y: 0` · `z: 0` · `scale: 1` · `scaleX: 1` · `scaleY: 1` · `rotate: 0`

```ts
// ✅ from-only — reveal animation: start hidden, animate INTO natural state
Motion('reveal', '.card', {
  from: { opacity: 0, y: 40 },
  duration: 0.6,
}).onScroll({ toggleActions: 'play none none none' });

// ✅ to-only — hover effect: start at natural state, animate TO custom values
Motion('lift', '.card', {
  to: { y: -8, boxShadow: '0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)' },
  duration: 0.3,
}).onHover({ each: true, onLeave: 'reverse' });

// ✅ to-only — parallax: FROM natural position (y:0), TO custom offset
Motion('parallax', '.hero-bg', {
  to: { y: -150 },
}).onScroll({ scrub: 1 });

// ✅ to-only — infinite pulse: FROM natural scale (1), TO custom scale
Motion('pulse', '.dot', {
  to: { scale: 1.2 },
  duration: 1,
  repeat: { times: -1, yoyo: true },
}).play();

// ✅ Both needed — mouse parallax: both endpoints are non-natural offsets
Motion('parallax-layer', '.layer', {
  from: { x: -40, y: -40 },
  to:   { x: 40,  y: 40  },
}).onMouseMove({ type: 'axis', smooth: 0.1 });

// ✅ Both needed — drawSVG: neither endpoint is a natural CSS default
Motion('draw', '#path', {
  from: { drawSVG: '0% 0%' },
  to:   { drawSVG: '0% 100%' },
  duration: 1,
}).onScroll({ scrub: true });

// ❌ Redundant — opacity:1, y:0, scale:1 are all natural defaults
Motion('bad', '.card', {
  from: { opacity: 0, y: 30, scale: 0.95 },
  to:   { opacity: 1, y: 0,  scale: 1    },   // ← drop this entire to
}).play();
```

**Exception — `Motion.set` + animation:** When you use `Motion.set()` to pre-position elements, the current CSS is no longer the natural state. In this case `to` is needed even for natural-looking values:

```ts
Motion.set('.card', { opacity: 0, y: 30 });   // current CSS is now opacity:0, y:30
Motion('cards-in', '.card', {
  to: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },   // ✅ needed: current CSS was overridden by Motion.set
  duration: 0.6,
  stagger: 0.08,
}).onPageLoad();
```

---

### Multi-Step Timeline Sequence
```ts
Motion('hero-sequence', [
  {
    target: '.hero-bg',
    from: { scale: 1.1, opacity: 0 },
    duration: 1,
    ease: 'power2.out',
  },
  {
    target: '.hero-title',
    from: { opacity: 0, y: 30 },
    duration: 0.8,
    ease: 'power3.out',
    position: '<0.3',      // 0.3s after bg starts
  },
  {
    target: '.hero-subtitle',
    from: { opacity: 0, y: 20 },
    duration: 0.6,
    ease: 'power2.out',
    position: '+=0.1',
  },
  {
    target: '.hero-cta',
    from: { opacity: 0, scale: 0.9 },
    duration: 0.5,
    ease: 'back.out',
    position: '<0.2',
  },
]).onPageLoad();
```

### Object Tweening (Non-DOM Targets)
```ts
// Animate plain objects — useful for canvas, WebGL, audio
const state = { progress: 0, hue: 0 };

Motion('canvas-anim', state, {
  to: { progress: 1, hue: 360 },
  duration: 3,
  ease: 'power2.inOut',
  repeat: -1,
  onUpdate: () => {
    // Use state.progress and state.hue in your canvas render loop
    requestAnimationFrame(render);
  },
}).play();
```

### CSS Custom Properties Animation
```ts
// Animate design tokens
Motion('theme-transition', ':root', {
  to: {
    '--color-primary': '#6200ea',
    '--spacing-lg': 48,
    '--border-radius': 16,
  },
  duration: 0.6,
  ease: 'power2.inOut',
}).onClick({ target: '#theme-btn', toggle: 'reverse' });
```

### FLIP Morph with FitConfig
```ts
// Morph source element to match destination position/size
Motion('card-expand', '.card-thumbnail', {
  fit: { target: '.card-fullscreen', resize: true },
  duration: 0.5,
  ease: 'power2.inOut',
}).onClick({ target: '.card-thumbnail' });
```

### Timeline Callbacks at Positions
```ts
Motion('sequence', '.items', {
  from: { opacity: 0, y: 30 },
  duration: 1,
  stagger: 0.1,
})
  .call(() => console.log('animation started'), [], 0)
  .call(() => console.log('halfway'), [], 0.5)
  .call(() => document.querySelector('.cta')?.classList.add('visible'), [], '>')
  .play();
```

### Infinite Loop with Yoyo
```ts
Motion('breathing', '.pulse-circle', {
  to: { scale: 1.15 },
  duration: 1.5,
  ease: 'sine.inOut',
  repeat: { times: -1, yoyo: true },
}).play();
```

### Dynamic Rebuild Pattern
```ts
function initAnimations() {
  // Kill old timeline before rebuilding (e.g., after resize)
  if (Motion.has('card-grid')) {
    Motion('card-grid').kill();
  }
  Motion.refreshScrollTriggers();

  const cards = Motion.utils.toArray('.card');
  Motion('card-grid', '.card', {
    from: { opacity: 0, y: 40 },
    duration: 0.6,
    stagger: { each: 0.08, from: 'start' },
  }).onScroll({ each: true, toggleActions: 'play none none none' });
}

window.addEventListener('resize', initAnimations);
initAnimations();
```

### Dynamic Content & SPA Pattern (Motion.context)
```ts
// Preferred: use Motion.context() for scoped lifecycle management
// Tracks all timelines created inside, enables clean teardown & reinit

// React
useEffect(() => {
  const ctx = Motion.context(() => {
    Motion('fade', '.card', { from: { opacity: 0, y: 30 }, duration: 0.6 }).onScroll({ scrub: true })
    Motion('hero', '.title', { from: { y: 50 }, duration: 0.8 }).onPageLoad()
  })
  return () => ctx.revert()  // clean teardown on unmount
}, [])

// Astro (View Transitions)
let ctx: MotionContext | undefined
document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', () => {
  ctx?.revert()
  ctx = Motion.context(() => { /* animations */ })
})

// After AJAX content change (WordPress filters, pagination, etc.)
ctx.refresh()  // kills old, re-runs init, re-resolves selectors

// Add more animations to existing context (lazy-loaded content)
ctx.add(() => {
  Motion('lazy', '.lazy-card', { from: { opacity: 0 }, duration: 0.5 }).onScroll({ scrub: true })
})
```

### Legacy SPA Cleanup (without context)
```ts
// Simpler but no reinit capability — use Motion.context() instead
function cleanup() {
  Motion.killAll();
  Motion.cleanup();
}

useEffect(() => {
  initAnimations();
  return cleanup;
}, []);
```

### Responsive Timelines (Motion.responsive)
```ts
// Register one named timeline with a factory per breakpoint tier.
// The manager activates the tier matching the viewport and live-swaps
// (killing the old timeline, building the new one) as the viewport
// crosses a boundary — no page reload, no manual matchMedia wiring.

Motion.responsive(
  'hero',
  {
    // Each variant BUILDS + REGISTERS its timeline (call a trigger inside)
    // and RETURNS it so the manager can kill it on the next swap.
    desktop: () =>
      Motion('hero', '.hero', { from: { x: -120, opacity: 0 }, duration: 1, ease: 'power3.out' }).onPageLoad(),
    phone: () =>
      Motion('hero', '.hero', { from: { y: 40, opacity: 0 }, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.out' }).onPageLoad(),
  },
  // Pixel boundaries (same values the builder stores).
  { laptops: 992, tablets: 768, phones: 576 }
);
// Sparse map above: laptop & tablet widths cascade UP to `desktop`.
```

```ts
// All four tiers + a scroll-driven variant. Use the SAME timeline name everywhere.
Motion.responsive(
  'gallery',
  {
    desktop: () =>
      Motion('gallery', '.panel', { to: { x: '-300%' }, duration: 1 })
        .onScroll({ scrub: true, pin: true, end: '+=3000' }),
    laptop: () =>
      Motion('gallery', '.panel', { to: { x: '-300%' }, duration: 1 })
        .onScroll({ scrub: true, pin: true, end: '+=2000' }),
    tablet: () =>
      Motion('gallery', '.panel', { from: { opacity: 0, y: 30 }, stagger: 0.1, duration: 0.6 })
        .onScroll({ toggleActions: 'play none none none' }),
    phone: () =>
      Motion('gallery', '.panel', { from: { opacity: 0 }, stagger: 0.08, duration: 0.5 })
        .onScroll({ toggleActions: 'play none none none' }),
  },
  { laptops: 992, tablets: 768, phones: 576 }
);

// The returned manager exposes getActiveTier() / destroy() for debugging & teardown.
// Motion.responsive() creates a NEW manager on every call — its first argument is NOT a
// registry key (unlike Motion()). Calling it twice for the same animation leaves the first
// manager's matchMedia listeners + active timeline running. Call the previous mgr.destroy()
// before re-registering.
const mgr = Motion.responsive('hero-responsive', { desktop: () => Motion('hero-responsive', '.hero', { from: { opacity: 0 } }).onPageLoad() }, { laptops: 992, tablets: 768, phones: 576 });
mgr?.getActiveTier(); // 'desktop' | 'laptop' | 'tablet' | 'phone' | null
```

### Set Initial State Before Animating
```ts
// Prevent flash of styled content
Motion.set('.card', { opacity: 0, y: 30 });

// Then animate in
Motion('cards-in', '.card', {
  to: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
  duration: 0.6,
  stagger: 0.08,
  ease: 'power2.out',
}).onPageLoad();
```

### Conditional Replay
```ts
// Check existence before replaying
if (Motion.has('hero')) {
  Motion('hero').restart();
} else {
  Motion('hero', '#hero', {
    from: { opacity: 0 },
    duration: 1,
  }).play();
}
```

## GSAP Migration

### gsap.to() → Motion()
```ts
// GSAP
gsap.to('.box', { x: 100, duration: 1, ease: 'power2.out' });

// Motion SDK
Motion('box-move', '.box', {
  to: { x: 100 },
  duration: 1,
  ease: 'power2.out',
}).play();
```

### gsap.timeline() → Motion() with array
```ts
// GSAP
const tl = gsap.timeline();
tl.from('.a', { y: -100, duration: 0.5 });
tl.from('.b', { opacity: 0, duration: 0.4 }, '<0.2');

// Motion SDK
Motion('my-tl', [
  { target: '.a', from: { y: -100 }, duration: 0.5 },
  { target: '.b', from: { opacity: 0 }, duration: 0.4, position: '<0.2' },
]).play();
```

### ScrollTrigger → .onScroll()
```ts
// GSAP
ScrollTrigger.create({
  trigger: '.section',
  start: 'top 80%',
  animation: gsap.from('.section', { opacity: 0, y: 40 }),
  toggleActions: 'play none none none',
});

// Motion SDK
Motion('scroll-section', '.section', {
  from: { opacity: 0, y: 40 },
  duration: 0.6,
}).onScroll({ start: 'top 80%', toggleActions: 'play none none none' });
```

### gsap.utils.* → Motion.utils.*
```ts
// GSAP
gsap.utils.toArray('.item');
gsap.utils.clamp(0, 100, value);

// Motion SDK
Motion.utils.toArray('.item');
Motion.utils.clamp(0, 100, value);
```
